instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Stop a build that takes a file from a package that did not declare it public: read the bundler's own list of what went into the finished bundle and report every import that reaches into a package's private files", and give it metafile_file (A path inside the granted folder to the bundler's metafile (JSON)); packages_root (A path inside the granted folder to the folder whose sub-folders are packages); declaration.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-a-bundle-against-package-boundaries and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give metafile_file (the bundler's metafile, esbuild's shape, a path inside the folder the person granted for reading), packages_root (the folder whose sub-folders are packages), declaration (how a package declares its public files: file, the name of the declaration file in each package folder; entries_at, the dotted path to the list in it; kind_at and kind, where each entry says what it is and the value that means public source; path_at, where it names the file or folder) and optionally bundle_root (what the metafile's relative paths are relative to; the granted folder when absent).
